mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, reducing propranolol metabolism and increasing its concentration, while propranolol may affect eslicarbazepine clearance through enzyme competition.
action: Monitor heart rate and blood pressure closely; propranolol dose may require adjustment upward if eslicarbazepine is added; monitor for loss of beta-blocker efficacy.
